behaviour: herdr is enabled whenever its binary is on the machine, on PATH or in ~/.local/bin: init configures it and init-agent opens agents in it whatever was answered or recorded before, the recorded choice only decides whether a missing herdr gets installed, and herdr cannot be disabled while installed.
seam: scripts.herdr_host binary, scripts.herdr_setup binary, init_step, status and main, scripts.init_agent _select_host
